title: Constant derived mapping sheaves of bounded finite complexes
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme with its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $B$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $E,G$ be bounded cochain complexes of $B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], each term a finite set. Write $\underline E,\underline G$ for their termwise constant sheaf complexes [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. The sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the derived Hom and Isom presheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-derived-map-presheaves] between $\underline E,\underline G$ are isomorphic respectively to the constant sheaves with values $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(E,G)$ and $\operatorname{Isom}_{D(B)}(E,G)$. The latter value may be empty.

proof.text: Define the natural maps from constant algebraic Hom and Isom presheaves to the derived mapping presheaves, using exact constant realization and etale inverse image.
The local derived-map lifting theorem makes the Hom comparison locally surjective.

On a nonempty etale scheme choose a geometric point. Exactness of its module stalk and the constant-stalk retraction make the derived constant functor faithful. Thus equality of algebraic maps after constant realization implies equality. On an empty object the bottom sieve covers. This proves local injectivity for Hom and, by taking homs of isomorphisms, for Isom.

Locally lift an isomorphism and its inverse through Hom. On a common refinement, local injectivity makes the two algebraic composites identities, giving an algebraic isomorphism. The Hom and Isom comparison maps are therefore locally bijective and sheafification makes both invertible. Transport through the exact constant functor localization comparison.

theorem finiteRing_constant_derived_mapping_sheaves
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (E G : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) ℤ)
    (hE : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n))
    (hG : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hEfin : ∀ n : ℤ, Finite (E.X n)) (hGfin : ∀ n : ℤ, Finite (G.X n)) :
    Nonempty
      (((presheafToSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
        (derivedHomPresheaf B
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G)))) ≅
        (constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) ∧
    Nonempty
      (((presheafToSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
        (derivedIsoPresheaf B
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G)))) ≅
        (constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))
